ety.text: Ultimately from Latin democratia and Ancient Greek δημοκρατία (dēmokratía). First attested in 1704 as димократия, mimicking the Greek pronunciation. The current form "демократия" most likely stems from German Demokratie. Had it been borrowed from French or Polish, it would have yielded "демокрация".

ety.text: From Proto-Slavic *ňaňa, a reduplicated nursery formation. The related form ня́нька (njánʹka) was first attested in the 12th century.
